title: The Community Story Summit
learning_focus: Term and grade synthesis: literary/informational comprehension, narrative/expository/persuasive composition, evidence, multimedia, cultural review, and audience.
story_premise: Representatives bring stories, reports, surveys, and media pieces to a summit. The Pathfinder must build a final exhibit with consent, evidence, and multiple viewpoints.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Term and grade synthesis: literary/informational comprehension, narrative/expository/persuasive composition, evidence, multimedia, cultural review, and audience.
